summary: Move Cron construction to functional options (WithLocation/WithParser/WithPanicLogger) with a per-instance parser and SecondOptional; touches cron.go, option.go, parser.go, docs and tests.
test_command: { go test . || go test -count=1 .; } && { go test ./... || go test -count=1 ./...; }
test_command_note: robfig/cron's own suite schedules real jobs and waits on wall-clock second boundaries (TestLocalTimezone/TestNonLocalTimezone are known to be timing-sensitive upstream). Each step allows one retry to absorb those flakes; the held-out tests are deterministic, so a retry cannot turn a wrong implementation into a pass. The root package runs first so the base-revision failure is the behavioural one (assert mode); the second step then requires the new option API in the bench_options package.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream refactor commit; that commit is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.fail_mode_note: Replaced the build-mode fixture in M4-04. The root-package hidden tests use only New(), AddFunc, Entry and Location (all present at base) and assert the new default parser semantics (5-field standard specs, 6-field specs rejected), so they compile at base and fail on behaviour. The option API (Option, WithLocation, WithParser, WithPanicLogger, SecondOptional) cannot be referenced without a compile error at base, so those tests live in a separate hidden external test package bench_options that the second step of the test command runs. Prompt unchanged.

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
